name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: The Devil in Me

locations.note: The prologue is set in H. H. Holmes's original World's Fair Hotel in Chicago during the 1893 World's Fair, where the newlyweds Jeff and Marie Whitman are murdered.

A film crew accepts an invitation to the island estate of Granthem Du'Met, which holds a replica of Holmes's Murder Castle; the hotel locks down and they are hunted through it until they escape by boat.
